title: Portuguese Vegan Fried Rice
description: A vegan twist on the classic Portuguese dish. Nutty flavors and textures come together in this satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: nut oil
ingredients.notes: or substitute with other vegan oil

instructions: Heat nut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chopped scallions and cook until softened, about 1 minute.
Add chopped cilantro and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
Add fried rice, nutty rice, and nutritional yeast to the skillet or wok.
Stir-fry until the rice is well combined and heated through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
